newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares continue advance in the week.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares continue advance in the week.

text.p: DOHA, OCT 31 (REUTER) - Financial stocks at Qatar's unofficial stock market continued to firm in the week to Thursday as shares continued their steady advance overall, brokers said.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's (CBQ) 18-share index inched up to 121.55 from 121.25 points in the previous week.

Among financial stocks, shares of four banks and one insurance company advanced during the week. The only decliner was Qatar Insurance, which dipped after a two-month bull run. All other shares remained unchanged.
The market leader, Qatar National Bank, moved up three riyals to 590 and Doha Bank Ltd gained two riyals to 275. The CBQ and Al Ahli Bank of Qatar gained one riyal each to 339 and 214 respectively.

In the insurance sector, Al Khaleej Insurance picked up three riyals to end the week at 295. Qatar Insurance shed two riyals to 678. Brokers said prices were stabilising after a non-stop rise in September and October.
Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company shares gained half a riyal to 52.50.
